main_body: A flat desert sand ground patch (4x3 tiles) with sparse speckle dots and small dune-streak marks; terrain tile, not a standing object.
top_band: none - flat ground texture, no top/front structure; the column is a repeating sand tone (#dbb26b) with occasional darker/lighter speckles
evidence: Terrain ground tile: the 3/4 contract for standing objects does not apply. The column scan shows only a uniform sand tone with scattered speckle pixels and no standing volume, so no top/front split is expected. No side faces or elevation drawn. Passes as terrain.

style.evidence: The candidate has only 5 distinct colours and a median of 5 per tile, against 26 per tile and 80 colours for the grass reference. The paving reference has 7 colours per tile, so it is closer, but the grass is the richer standard for a natural ground. The sand has 4 usable tones (base, mid, dark, highlight) plus one deep brown accent. Speckles are sparse single pixels on a dominant flat base. The 4-pixel streak marks repeat identically at a regular spacing every 16 px, and the same speckle layout tiles visibly across the patch. There are no 5x5 flat blocks (0%), but the base colour dominates and there are no clumps, grain variety or tonal drift like the grass reference. Without outlines, the dark-edge check is not applicable. Much thinner than the grass reference in colours and variation, so it fails.
